meta.name: reverse-document
meta.description: 从现有实现生成设计或架构文档。从代码/原型逆向工作，创建缺失的规划文档。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从现有代码生成设计或架构文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有代码但缺少设计文档，需要逆向生成架构说明。
copy.tagline_en: Generate design or architecture docs from existing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have existing code but lack design documents and need to reverse-engineer architecture descriptions.

howto.what: Claude 会分析你指定的代码或原型，然后生成对应的设计文档（如游戏设计文档）、架构文档（如架构决策记录）或概念文档。它会先展示发现并询问你的设计意图，再根据你的回答起草文档，请求批准后写入文件。
howto.when: 当你输入 /reverse-document 命令并指定类型（design/architecture/concept）和路径时触发。或当你描述一个已实现但缺少文档的系统时，Claude 也可能主动建议使用此技能。

say.text: 请帮我为 src/gameplay/combat 生成一份战斗设计文档。
我刚刚写了一个原型，帮我从里面提取概念文档。
say.note: Claude 会分析原型文件，生成概念文档并请求批准。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your code or prototype and generates corresponding design documents (e.g., GDD), architecture documents (e.g., ADR), or concept documents. It first shows findings and asks about your design intent, then drafts the document based on your answers, and writes it after approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you issue the /reverse-document command with a type (design/architecture/concept) and path. Alternatively, when you mention lacking documentation for existing code, Claude may proactively offer to use this skill.

say_en.text: Please generate a combat design document for src/gameplay/combat.
I just finished a prototype; extract a concept document from it.
